_about: Extra ledger entries that scripts/load_fixtures.py adds on top of mock_input_output/. Everything else comes from those mock files, so there is only one copy of the data.

before_scores._why: recent_push got a Quiet Help push 12 days before AS_OF, so the 30-day rule keeps them OFF the Quiet Help list. M-0100 so it never clashes with E's sample messages (M-0001...).

hero_before_form._why: hero's interaction score BEFORE the hardship form (2 contacts, no keywords). The mock B output only has the score AFTER the form (50).
